Registry burns only if redeemedAmount>0 and has no empty-set require. A call that passes amount/fee checks and matches no redeemable branch/trove can complete with zero fill. Other independent reverts must not be relabelled as the missing named empty-set guard.

findings.title: V1 live guard is totalETHDrawn>0, broader than empty eligible set
findings.reasoning_summary: Line 999 requires totals.totalETHDrawn>0. That fires on empty iteration, cancelled first partial with no prior fill, rounding-zero ETHLot, and a positive maxIterations cap that adds no lot. ETHLot is floor(LUSDLot*1e18/price) and can be 0 while LUSDLot>0. The required 24.1/24.3 case is refusal when no redeemable trove exists, not every no-collateral-drawn revert.
findings.required_action: Freeze the actual predicate as no-collateral-drawn. Record empty-set as a distinct observation. Do not treat cancelled-partial or rounding-zero as empty-set.

findings.title: Empty-set refusal is not established; earlier guards and last-trove close can pre-empt line 999
findings.reasoning_summary: Before 999: max fee, 14-day bootstrap via missing LQTY token, priceFeed.fetchPrice, TCR>=MCR, amount>0, user balance, assert(balance<=system debt). _closeTrove always requires more than one trove, so emptying the list through close is source-blocked. All-ICR<MCR is in tension with TCR>=MCR if TCR is the debt-weighted average of current ICRs. None of this is a proof that empty-set is unreachable. No executed witness exists.
findings.required_action: Execute the specified empty-set witness, or report the actual revert of a failed construction. Do not claim unreachable without a proof. Do not close 24.1.

findings.title: Payment/debt correspondence must include gas reserve, pending rewards, fee, and SafeMath floor
findings.reasoning_summary: Redeemer burn is totalLUSDToRedeem; full close additionally burns LUSD_GAS_COMPENSATION from the gas pool and decreases ActivePool debt by that reserve. Pending rewards are applied before the lot. Fee is subtracted from drawn ETH after line 999. Naive burn==debtDecrease is false on full close. ETHLot floor can be zero.
findings.required_action: Include reserve and pending-reward boundaries in any payment/debt proof, or name a partial-only domain. The payment-without-debt-reduction negative must not be the reserve itself.

findings.required_action: Name the sentinel in the observation schema. Do not model 0 as no-loop.
